method: Record numerical or categorical values NASA explicitly reports for a particular current or structure on its 2011 Perpetual Ocean story, Perpetual Ocean 2 Western Boundary Currents page, or narrated film. These are source descriptions, not OSW measurements or global extrema. Eddy diameter, current speed, temperature, salinity, lifetime, depth, and relative transport are separate quantities and never current-length estimates.

properties.scope_note: NASA's 2011 introductory story describes the Gulf Stream and Kuroshio as examples of currents carrying warm water at speeds greater than 4 mph; no averaging interval, location, or method is supplied. This is a source-era description, not a series-wide minimum.
